name: Suno V6
description: Suno V6 is Suno's flagship v6 music-generation model. It is described as reliable and precise, with polished music generation across genres and styles, and is available to Pro and Premier subscribers.

details.name: availability
details.value: Available to Pro and Premier subscribers.

details.name: supported_inputs
details.value: Suno describes creation with text, audio, images, and video.

details.name: pricing
details.value: The announcement does not publish an API price or per-generation credit rate.

page_notice.markdown: Suno V6 is a consumer product release for Pro and Premier subscribers. Suno has not published an official API model ID or API pricing in this announcement, so no Phaseo API route is asserted.

sources.notes: Official announcement dated September 9, 2026 names v6, describes its flagship role and Pro/Premier availability, and lists text, audio, image, and video creation inputs.

verification.notes: Official product name, release date, subscriber availability, and product modalities verified. API model ID, API route, and API pricing remain unpublished.
